answer: Per-identity stake + slashing. Before voting or grading, every identity must lock a 50 USDC deposit in the registry escrow; duplicate-vote proof slashes that deposit. A farm of 1000 clones pays 1000×50 = 50,000 USDC; when the audit traces the clone vine (one-to-many transaction graph) and the river (single-source funding flow) to one wallet, it slashes the whole reef (clustered stake pool), forfeiting all 50,000 USDC. Honesty stays cheaper.
